fields.description: Path: epic. Server on Cloudflare (`blrby.app`): accounts and one library across devices. First finish line (owner 2026-11-03) = phases 1 and 2 only: server foundation, then desktop sign-in (Google, Microsoft, email, Apple), sync of books, positions, highlights, notes and settings, and offline books; plan limits exist only as settings and everyone is Unlimited. Phases 3 (payments) and 4 (Kokoro server narration) follow the first finish line. Charter draft: `docs/planning/holding/2026-10-23-blurby-server/charter-draft.md`; scope: `docs/planning/holding/2026-11-03-first-finish-line.md`.
